title: School — choose the composition
question: Several courses; 'study next' decided by a mix of nearest due date, hours behind your weekly plan, and weakest topic. Links per course, study sessions logged, assignments ticked off. Same world. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Study-next card over course tiles
options.lineage: the study-app dashboard: one recommendation, a tile per course
options.thesis: The page opens on one white card — what to study now, and why (due Thursday · 2 h behind plan · confidence 2 of 5) — with 'Start a session'. Beneath, a tile per course carrying hours vs plan, next due, confidence and its links; the due ledger runs down the right.
materials: ruled course tiles on paper (no second card)
serif numerals for hours and confidence
options.viewport: Band: 'School', italic 'Autumn term · 4 courses · exam in 12 days'. Paper: left 8/12 — the Study-next card, then 'Courses' as a 2×2 grid of ruled tiles (name, hours this week of plan, next due, confidence dots, links); right 4/12 — 'Due' ledger (date · item · course, checkbox), then 'Sessions' log with an add line.
options.risk: Tiles are the category's default arrangement; with 6+ courses the grid pushes the ledger below the fold.

regions.label: band: School · term · exam in 12 days
Study next (card): course · topic · why · Start a session

options.label: One column per course
options.lineage: the term planner: courses side by side, the week read across
options.thesis: Each course is a ruled column — name, hours this week vs plan, confidence, its due items as a checklist, its links — so the term reads left to right. The recommended course's column carries the one white card at its head ('Study this next') and the others stay on paper.
materials: one white card at the head of the recommended column
session add line in the foot
options.viewport: Band: 'School', italic term line. Paper: four equal columns (Networking, Databases, Statistics, Writing): each with a serif name, 'this week 3 h of 5', confidence dots, 'Due' checklist, 'Links'. The Networking column head is the white card with the why-line and 'Start a session'. Foot, full width: 'Sessions' log with add line.
options.risk: Four+ columns at 1180px are ~260px each; long assignment titles wrap; on mobile columns stack and the comparison is lost.

options.label: A ranked stack with reasons
options.lineage: the tutor's list: what to do, in order, with the reason written beside each
options.thesis: The page is a ranked ledger of what to study — every item shows its reason in plain words (due Thu · 2 h behind plan · confidence 2/5); the top item opens by default to show its links and a 'Start a session' line. Courses sit in a compact rail on the right with hours vs plan and confidence you can nudge.
materials: the open item is the page's white card
a course rail of ruled rows with confidence dots
options.viewport: Band: 'School', italic 'Autumn term · exam in 12 days · 4 h of 8 h this week'. Paper: left 8/12 'Study, in order' — ranked rows: rank figure, course + topic/assignment, the reason line, due date; the first row expanded as the card with links and a session line; done items sink. Right 4/12 'Courses' rail: name, hours of plan, confidence dots (click to set), 'Add course'. Beneath the stack: 'Sessions' log with add line, 'Add an item' form.
options.risk: The ranking must be legible or it reads as arbitrary; reasons need to stay one line.
